name: analytics-verify
description: Verification loop for analytics and research deliverables: claim ledger, mechanical check script, independent verifier on a fresh context, re-check of every fix, and a receipt bound to the exact file sent.

interface.shortDescription: Claim ledger, check script and independent verifier for analytics
interface.longDescription: Binds every number and fact in an analytics deliverable to its source, checks the binding with a script, hands the deliverable to an independent verifier on a fresh context, re-checks every fix, and ties the verifier's receipt to the exact file that is sent.
defaultPrompt: Verify this analysis before I send it.
Cross-check these numbers as an independent verifier.
